title: Grace Period
description: The Grace Period Mod allows players to respawn and continue playing during a configurable grace window.
body:
# Grace Period Mod
Experience a forgiving take on hardcore survival multiplayer. The Grace Period Mod allows players to respawn and continue playing during a configurable grace window instead of being forced into spectator mode immediately upon death—perfect for SMP servers where you want stakes without permanent loss.

## Key Features

### ✨ Configurable Grace Window
Set any duration (default 1 hour) for respawning after death. Hardcore mode restrictions are automatically lifted during the grace period.

### ⚱️ Corpse & Grave System
Bodies leave behind a barrel grave with a player head marker at the death location. All inventory items are automatically captured, preventing duplicate drops and making loot recovery intuitive.

### 🛡️ PvP Control
PvP damage is blocked during the grace period while PvE damage remains enabled, keeping the challenge alive and preventing spawn-camping.

### ⚙️ In-Game Admin Commands
Full control without server restarts:

/graceperiod status — View active state and remaining time.

/graceperiod set duration <seconds> — Adjust grace window length.

/graceperiod set createCorpse <true|false> — Toggle grave system.

/graceperiod set showGraceNotifications <true|false> — Control chat broadcasts.
